title: Every decoder layer in Qwen3.8-Flash-Next utilizes a 512-expert Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) block with top-10 softmax routing and 1 scalar-gated shared expert, providing 180B total parameter capacity with bounded active compute per token. Implementing this architecture requires 3D-stacked routed expert parameters, vectorized gather/einsum dispatch, float32 router probabilities with top-k sum normalization, and scalar-gated shared expert combination aligned with reference PyTorch semantics.
